claim: The late-fee calculator charges 0.50 a day after a 3-day grace period, stops at 10.00, and waives the fee for staff members.
why: Three parts hold: the grace period, the daily rate and the cap all come from config.py and are applied in the right order. The staff waiver compares the role to lowercase staff, but the loader capitalizes every role to Staff, so the waiver never fires. A reader of fees.py alone sees the check and trusts it; only the loader or a run shows Boris is charged 3.50.

deciding.note: loader capitalizes role so the check never matches

root.claim: Late-fee calculator: 0.50/day after 3 days grace, cap 10.00, staff waived

atoms.claim: Fee is 0.50 per day after a 3-day grace period
atoms.evidence: config.py sets GRACE_DAYS=3, RATE_PER_DAY=0.5; fees.py bills days_late-3. Run: Ana 5 days -> 1.00, 3 days -> 0.00.
fees.py applies min(..., CAP) with CAP=10.0; Cleo 30 days -> 10.00.

atoms.claim: Staff members pay no late fee
atoms.evidence: fees.py tests role == 'staff' but members.load() capitalizes roles to 'Staff', so the test never matches. Run: Boris (staff) 10 days -> 3.50.
